# Before Submitting an Issue

Please take a moment to read this before opening a new issue:

1. **Search Existing Issues**: Please search the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/masrigaa/Denge-MusicApp/issues)
   and [Pull Requests](https://github.com/masrigaa/Denge-MusicApp/pulls) first to see if your bug or feature request
   has already been reported or discussed.
2. **Update to Latest Version**: Verify if your issue still occurs on the latest version of Déngé.
3. **Provide Complete Information**: When reporting bugs, fill in all required fields in the template, including
   your device model, Android version, app version, and relevant logcat output.

Thank you for helping keep the Déngé issue tracker clean and productive!
